about.title: About
paragraphs: A freelance product coach and agile coach based in Lille, France, I have spent over ten years working alongside product teams in demanding environments (retail, marketplaces, fintech, energy), helping them shape their strategy, speed up delivery and connect goals to real impact. I am a practitioner, not a theorist.
And I live what I coach from the inside: alongside my consulting work, I am co-founding Le Berceau de Location, with its constant trade-offs, its discovery work and its go-to-market.
My roots are technical: developer, then systems and network engineer, before moving into agility and product in 2016.
I work on site in Lille and across the Lille metropolitan area (Villeneuve-d'Ascq, Lesquin, Roubaix, Tourcoing, Marcq-en-Barœul), and more widely in the Hauts-de-France region.

berceau.title: Le Berceau de Location
pitch: Le Berceau de Location is a marketplace for renting baby gear between parents and professional rental shops. Strollers, travel cots, car seats: most childcare equipment is only used for a few months.

Instead of buying new, parents rent close to home or at their holiday destination, from other parents or from professional renters. Owners earn a little from gear that would otherwise gather dust in the attic. No online payment, and a real person who answers within 24 hours.
Less spending for families, less waste for the planet.

values.title: Circular economy
values.detail: Give quality gear a second life instead of manufacturing more of it.

values.title: Social impact
values.detail: Make quality equipment accessible to every family, for exactly as long as it is needed.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: What people usually ask me before starting a product coaching or agile coaching engagement.

items.q: What does a product coach do?
items.a: A product coach helps teams and their leaders decide better what to build, and why: clarifying the vision, linking strategy to goals (OKRs), prioritising by value, setting up continuous discovery and measuring impact. I work alongside Product Managers, Product Owners and managers, on their real problems.

items.q: What is the difference between a product coach and an agile coach?
items.a: An agile coach focuses on how people work: rituals, flow, collaboration across teams, agility at scale (SAFe, Nexus). A product coach focuses on what gets built and the impact it has. I do both: I was a Scrum Master and an agile coach before becoming a product coach, and real blockers almost always mix the two.

I am based in Lille, France, and work on site across the Lille metropolitan area (Lille, Villeneuve-d'Ascq, Lesquin, Roubaix, Tourcoing, Marcq-en-Barœul) and the Hauts-de-France region. For another location or a remote setup, let's talk.

items.q: What kind of engagements do you offer?
items.a: Freelance product coaching and agile coaching engagements through LBN Consulting, transformation support (OKRs, Quarter Planning, multi-team synchronisation, delivery), mentoring for Product Managers and Product Owners, and training in product management and agility.

items.q: Do you work with startups as well as large companies?
items.a: Yes. I have worked with large retail, energy and finance companies (Boulanger, Leroy Merlin, ADEO, Enercoop, CACEIS), and I am co-founding a startup myself, Le Berceau de Location. I know trade-offs with scarce resources as well as coordinating dozens of teams.
Book a slot online, or message me on LinkedIn or Malt. We go over your context and what is getting stuck, with no commitment.
